verses.geez: ወደገመ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: And Job continued and said in his parable,

translations.lxx: And Job continued and said in his parable,
translations.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
translations.ron: Apoi Iov a mers mai departe cu pildele sale şi a zis:

verses.geez: መኑ፡ እምአግብአኒ፡ ውስተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አውራኅየ፡ ዘትካት፡ ከመ፡ አመ፡ ዓቀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Oh that I were as in months past, wherein God preserved me!

translations.lxx: Oh that I were as in months past, wherein God preserved me!
translations.kjv: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
translations.ron: "O, dacă aş fi încă o dată ca în lunile de mai înainte, ca în zilele când Dumnezeu mă ocrotea,

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ይበርህ፡ ማኅቶት፡ በትርአስየ፡ ወአመ፡ አሐውር፡ በብርሃኑ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት።
verses.translation: As when his lamp shone over my head; when by his light I walked through darkness.

translations.lxx: As when his lamp shone over my head; when by his light I walked through darkness.
translations.kjv: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
translations.ron: Ca atunci când El ţinea strălucitoare deasupra capului meu candela Sa şi, luminat de ea, eu străbăteam prin întuneric!

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ በረከት፡ ወአመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይሄውጽ፡ ቤትየ።
verses.translation: As when I steadfastly pursued my ways, when God took care of my house.

translations.lxx: As when I steadfastly pursued my ways, when God took care of my house.
translations.kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
translations.ron: De ce nu sunt încă o dată ca în zilele toamnei mele, când Dumnezeu ţinea parte cortului meu,

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ጽፉቅ፡ ንዋይየ፡ ወበዓውድየ፡ አግብርትየ።
verses.translation: When I was very fruitful, and my children were about me;

translations.lxx: When I was very fruitful, and my children were about me;
translations.kjv: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
translations.ron: Când Cel Atotputernic era încă cu mine şi împrejurul meu stăteau feciorii mei,

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ይውኅዝ፡ ቅብዕ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናውየ፡ ወአመ፡ ይትከዓው፡ ሐሊብ፡ ውስተ፡ አድባርየ።
verses.translation: when my ways were moistened with butter, and the mountains flowed for me with milk.

translations.lxx: when my ways were moistened with butter, and the mountains flowed for me with milk.
translations.kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
translations.ron: Iar picioarele mele se scăldau în lapte şi stânca aspră izvora pentru mine pâraie de untdelemn?

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ እገይሥ፡ በግርማ፡ ሀገርየ፡ ወአነብር፡ መንበርየ፡ ውሰተ፡ መርኅብ።
verses.translation: When I went forth early in the city, and the seat was placed for me in the streets.

translations.lxx: When I went forth early in the city, and the seat was placed for me in the streets.
translations.kjv: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
translations.ron: Atunci când ieşeam la poarta de sus a cetăţii şi aşezam în piaţă scaunul meu,

verses.geez: ይሬዩኒ፡ ወራዙት፡ ወይትኀብኡኒ፡ ወይጸንሑኒ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሊዋውንት።
verses.translation: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and all the old men stood up.

translations.lxx: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and all the old men stood up.
translations.kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
translations.ron: Tineretul, văzându-mă, se ascundea cu sfială, iar cei bătrâni se ridicau în picioare şi rămâneau aşa.

verses.geez: ወኃያልንሂ፡ ይትፈፀሙ፡ ወኢይነብቡ፡ ወያጠውቁ፡ አፉ፡ ሆሙ፡ በእደዊሆሙ።
verses.translation: And the great men ceased speaking, and laid their finger on their mouth.

translations.lxx: And the great men ceased speaking, and laid their finger on their mouth.
translations.kjv: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
translations.ron: Fruntaşii poporului îşi opreau cuvântările şi îşi puneau mâna la gură.

verses.geez: ወያስተበፅዑኒ፡ እለ፡ ሰንዑኒ፡ ወይጠግዕ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ በጕርዔሆሙ።
verses.translation: And they that heard me blessed me, and their tongue clave to their throat.

translations.lxx: And they that heard me blessed me, and their tongue clave to their throat.
translations.kjv: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
translations.ron: Glasul căpeteniilor scădea şi limba lor se lipea de cerul gurii.

verses.geez: ወዕዝን፡ እንተ፡ ሰማዓተኒ፡ ታስተበፅዓኒ፡ ወዓይን፡ እንተ፡ ርእየተኒ፡ ትትሬሠየኒ።
verses.translation: For the ear heard, and blessed me; and the eye saw me, and turned aside.

translations.lxx: For the ear heard, and blessed me; and the eye saw me, and turned aside.
translations.kjv: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
translations.ron: Căci urechea care mă auzea mă fericea şi ochiul care mă vedea îmi dădea mare mărturie.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቸድኃንኩ፡ ነዳየ፡ እምእደ፡ ዘይትዔገሎ፡ ወረዳእኩ፡ እጓለ፡ ማውታ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ረዳኢ።
verses.translation: For I saved the poor out of the hand of the oppressor, and helped the fatherless who had no helper.

translations.lxx: For I saved the poor out of the hand of the oppressor, and helped the fatherless who had no helper.
translations.kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
translations.ron: Fiindcă scăpam de pieire pe cel sărman care striga după ajutor şi pe orfanul fără sprijin.

verses.geez: ወደኃረኒ፡ ይመውት፡ ወባረከኒ፡ አፈ፡ ዕቤራት።
verses.translation: Let the blessing of the perishing one come upon me; yea, the mouth of the widow has blessed me.

translations.lxx: Let the blessing of the perishing one come upon me; yea, the mouth of the widow has blessed me.
translations.kjv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
translations.ron: Binecuvântările celui ce era gata să piară veneau asupră-mi şi umpleam de bucurie inima văduvei.

verses.geez: ወለበስክዋ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ወተረሠይኩ፡ ርትዐ፡ ከመ፡ ዓጽፍ፡ ወተቀጸልክዋ፡ ለፍትሕ።
verses.translation: Also I put on righteousness, and clothed myself with judgment like a mantle.

translations.lxx: Also I put on righteousness, and clothed myself with judgment like a mantle.
translations.kjv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
translations.ron: Mă îmbrăcam întru dreptate, ca într-un veşmânt şi judecata mea cea dreaptă era mantia mea şi turbanul meu.

verses.geez: ወኮንክዎሙ፡ ዓይነ፡ ለዕውራን፡ ወእግረ፡ ለስቡራን።
verses.translation: I was the eye of the blind, and the foot of the lame.

translations.lxx: I was the eye of the blind, and the foot of the lame.
translations.kjv: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
translations.ron: Eram ochii celui orb şi piciorul celui şchiop;

verses.geez: አነ፡ ውእቱ፡ አበ፡ ምስኪናን፡ ወተኃሠሥኩ፡ ለዘኢየአምር፡ ቅስተ።
verses.translation: I was the father of the helpless; and I searched out the cause which I knew not.

translations.lxx: I was the father of the helpless; and I searched out the cause which I knew not.
translations.kjv: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
translations.ron: Eram tatăl celor neputincioşi şi cercetam cu sârguinţă pricinile care îmi erau necunoscute.

verses.geez: ወሰበርኩ፡ ስነኒሆሙ፡ ለዓማዕያን፡ ወአንገፍክዎሙ፡ እማእከለ፡ ጥረሲሆሙ፡ ዘመሰጡ።
verses.translation: And I broke the jaw-teeth of the unrighteous; I plucked the spoil out of the midst of their teeth.

translations.lxx: And I broke the jaw-teeth of the unrighteous; I plucked the spoil out of the midst of their teeth.
translations.kjv: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
translations.ron: Sfărâmam fălcile nelegiuitului şi smulgeam prada din dinţii lui.

verses.geez: ወተሐዘብኩሰ፡ እልኃቅ፡ ወእርሳዕ፡ ወእሕየው፡ ጕንዱየ፡ ዓመታተ፡ ከመ፡ ነዋኅ፡ በቀልተ፡ ተመርት፡ ወከመ፡ ኆፃ፡ አበዝኅ፡ መዋዕለ።
verses.translation: And I said, My age shall continue as the stem of a palm-tree; I shall live a long while.

translations.lxx: And I said, My age shall continue as the stem of a palm-tree; I shall live a long while.
translations.kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
translations.ron: Şi îmi ziceam: Voi adormi în cuibul meu şi ca pasărea Phoenix voi înmulţi zilele mele.

verses.geez: ወይትከዓው፡ ማይለሥርውየ፡ ወይወርድ፡ ጠል፡ ውስተ፡ ማአረርየ።
verses.translation: My root was spread out by the water, and the dew would lodge on my crop.

translations.lxx: My root was spread out by the water, and the dew would lodge on my crop.
translations.kjv: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
translations.ron: Rădăcina mea se va răsfira pe lângă apă şi roua se va lăsa, noaptea, peste ramurile mele.

verses.geez: ወክብርየ፡ ሐዲስ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ወአሐውር፡ እንዘ፡ ቀስትየ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴየ።
verses.translation: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow prospered in his hand.

translations.lxx: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow prospered in his hand.
translations.kjv: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
translations.ron: Slava mea va întineri neîncetat şi arcul meu se va înnoi în mâna mea.

verses.geez: ኪያየ፡ ያረምኡኒ፡ ወይሰምዑኒ፡ ወያረምሙ፡ በምክረ፡ ዚአየ።
verses.translation: Men heard me, and gave heed, and they were silent at my counsel.

translations.lxx: Men heard me, and gave heed, and they were silent at my counsel.
translations.kjv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
translations.ron: Oamenii mă ascultau şi stăteau fără grai şi aşteptau să audă sfatul meu.

verses.geez: ወኢይደግሙ፡ ነገረ፡ በዲበ፡ ነገርየ፡ ወይትኃሠዩ፡ ሶበ፡ እትናገሮሙ።
verses.translation: At my word they spoke not again, and they were very glad whenever I spoke to them.

translations.lxx: At my word they spoke not again, and they were very glad whenever I spoke to them.
translations.kjv: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
translations.ron: După ce le vorbeam eu, ei nu mai spuneau nimic şi cuvântul meu cădea asupra lor picătură cu picătură.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ምድር፡ ጽምአት፡ እንተ፡ ትሴፎ፡ ዝናመ፡ ከማሁ፡ እሙንቱሂ፡ ለነገር።
verses.translation: As the thirsty earth expecting the rain, so they waited for my speech.

translations.lxx: As the thirsty earth expecting the rain, so they waited for my speech.
translations.kjv: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
translations.ron: Mă aşteptau precum aştepţi ploaia şi căscau gura lor, ca pentru bura de primăvară.

verses.geez: ወኢይትአመኑ፡ አመ፡ ሰሐቁ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ወኢወድቀ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ገጽየ።
verses.translation: Were I to laugh on them, they would not believe it; and the light of my face has not failed.

translations.lxx: Were I to laugh on them, they would not believe it; and the light of my face has not failed.
translations.kjv: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
translations.ron: Dacă le surâdeam, nu-şi credeau ochilor şi surâsul meu nu-l lăsau să se piardă.

verses.geez: ኃሢሥየ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ነበርኩ፡ እንዘ፡ እኴንኖሙ፡ ወነበርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ ወሶበ፡ ይላህዉ፡ ይትናዘዙ፡ ብየ።
verses.translation: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the midst of warriors, as one comforting mourners.

translations.lxx: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the midst of warriors, as one comforting mourners.
translations.kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
translations.ron: Le arătam care este dreapta cale şi stăteam mereu în fruntea lor, stăteam ca un împărat, între ostaşii săi şi, oriunde-i duceam, ei veneau după mine.
